profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Exelon
profile.summary:
Full stack Software engineer with 17 years of experience across a diverse range of technologies and domains. Proficient in both frontend and backend development, with expertise in frameworks such as C#, Node.js, React.js, Angular, and PHP. Skilled in database management, cloud platforms, version control systems, and agile methodologies. Proven track record of delivering high-quality solutions in domains including energy, healthcare, finance, e-commerce, and software as a product.

Technical Skills:

Languages: JavaScript (Node.js, Angular, React.js), TypeScript, C#, PHP, Python, Java, HTML5, CSS
Frameworks/Libraries: Express, Next.js, Redux, IONIC, Laravel, Zend, Symfony, Drupal, Magento, Bootstrap, Material UI
Databases: MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
APIs/Protocols: REST, SOAP, GraphQL
Tools/Platforms: GitLab, SVN, Jenkins, AWS, Azure, Heroku, Docker, Kubernetes, Shell Script, Groovy Script, Visual Studio Code, Scrum, Jira, Trello
Testing: PhpUnit, Protractor, Karma, Jest, Chai, Mocha
Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, Iterative SDLCs
